rows.text: The party-organ notice for 自由民主 No. 2247, posted 25 September 2006, says 安倍晋三 has been chosen as the 21st LDP president, succeeding 小泉純一郎総裁 after five years and five months, and that the party will face next year's upper-house election united under 安倍新総裁.
